For reaction A rightarrow P, rate constant k = 1.5 × 10³text{ s}^{-1} at 27^circtext{C}. If activation energy for the above reaction is 60text{ kJ mol}^{-1}, then the temperature in ^circtext{C} at which rate constant, k = 4.5 × 10³text{ s}^{-1} is _______. Nearest integer

question.plainText: For reaction A rightarrow P, rate constant k = 1.5 times 10^3text{ s}^{-1} at 27^circtext{C}. If activation energy for the above reaction is 60text{ kJ mol}^{-1}, then the temperature in ^circtext{C} at which rate constant, k = 4.5 times 10^3text{ s}^{-1} is _______. Nearest integer Given : log 2 = 0.30, log 3 = 0.48, R = 8.3text{ J K}^{-1}text{ mol}^{-1}, ln 10 = 2.3

explanation.latex:
Using the Arrhenius equation:
$\ln \left(\frac{k_2}{k_1}\right) = \frac{E_a}{R} \left(\frac{1}{T_1} - \frac{1}{T_2}\right)$
Given $k_1 = 1.5 \times 10^3$, $k_2 = 4.5 \times 10^3$, $T_1 = 27^\circ\text{C} = 300\text{ K}$, $E_a = 60000\text{ J/mol}$.
$\frac{k_2}{k_1} = \frac{4.5 \times 10^3}{1.5 \times 10^3} = 3$.
$\ln(3) = 2.3 \times \log(3) = 2.3 \times 0.48 = 1.104$.
Substitute into the equation:
$1.104 = \frac{60000}{8.3} \left(\frac{1}{300} - \frac{1}{T_2}\right)$
$\frac{1}{300} - \frac{1}{T_2} = \frac{1.104 \times 8.3}{60000} = \frac{9.1632}{60000} \approx 0.0001527$
$\frac{1}{T_2} = \frac{1}{300} - 0.0001527 = 0.0033333 - 0.0001527 = 0.0031806\text{ K}^{-1}$.
$T_2 = \frac{1}{0.0031806} \approx 314.4\text{ K}$.
Converting to Celsius: $T_2 = 314.4 - 273.15 = 41.25^\circ\text{C}$.
The nearest integer is $41$.

question.latex:
Consider the following gas phase reaction being carried out in a closed vessel at $25^\circ\text{C}$.
$2A$g$ \rightarrow 4B$g$ + C$g$$
At time $30\text{ min}$, the total pressure of the system is $300\text{ mm Hg}$. At time $t = \infty$, the total pressure is $600\text{ mm Hg}$. The pressure of $C$g$$ at $30\text{ minutes}$ time interval would be _______ mm Hg.
question.unicode:
Consider the following gas phase reaction being carried out in a closed vessel at 25^circtext{C}.
2Ag rightarrow 4Bg + Cg
At time 30text{ min}, the total pressure of the system is 300text{ mm Hg}. At time t = ∞, the total pressure is 600text{ mm Hg}. The pressure of Cg at 30text{ minutes} time interval would be _______ mm Hg.
question.plainText: Consider the following gas phase reaction being carried out in a closed vessel at 25^circtext{C}. 2Ag rightarrow 4Bg + Cg At time 30text{ min}, the total pressure of the system is 300text{ mm Hg}. At time t = infty, the total pressure is 600text{ mm Hg}. The pressure of Cg at 30text{ minutes} time interval would be _______ mm Hg.

explanation.latex:
Let initial pressure of A be $P_0$.
At $t = \infty$, reactant A is completely consumed. 2 moles of A yield 5 moles of gaseous products (4B + 1C).
So, final pressure $P_\infty = \frac{5}{2} P_0 = 600 \implies P_0 = 240\text{ mm Hg}$.
At $t = 30\text{ min}$, let $2p$ be the drop in pressure of A.
$P_A = 240 - 2p$, $P_B = 4p$, $P_C = p$.
Total pressure $P_{total} = (240 - 2p) + 4p + p = 240 + 3p$.
Given $P_{total} = 300\text{ mm Hg}$ at $30\text{ min}$.
$240 + 3p = 300 \implies 3p = 60 \implies p = 20\text{ mm Hg}$.
Since $P_C = p$, the pressure of C at $30\text{ minutes}$ is $20\text{ mm Hg}$.
